text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The night after the race, I spot Grass<n>Wonder all by
herself on the track.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, the shame... How could I let this<n>happen?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The top is nothing but a distant dream<n>if I can't
even handle this much of a<n>load.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I will need to work much, much harder<n>if I am to live
up to my own<n>standards, let alone prevail over
others...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's clearly at her wit's end. It<n>might be a good
idea to reconsider<n>her schedule.
